badgeTitle.fieldDescription: Text displayed in the badge area (e.g., 'WHO WE ARE', 'VIDEO DEMO')
badgeTitle.name: ./badgeTitle

mainTitle.fieldDescription: The main headline text for the section
mainTitle.name: ./mainTitle

description.fieldDescription: The description text that appears below the title (supports rich text formatting)
description.name: ./description

mediaType.fieldDescription: Select the type of media to display in the blob-shaped container
mediaType.name: ./mediaType

primaryAssetPath.fieldDescription: Select an image from DAM to display in the blob-shaped container
primaryAssetPath.name: ./primaryAssetPath

primaryAssetAlt.fieldDescription: Alternative text for the image (for accessibility)
primaryAssetAlt.name: ./primaryAssetAlt

primaryVideoPath.fieldDescription: Select a video file (MP4, WebM, etc.) from DAM. Video will auto-play when visible.
primaryVideoPath.name: ./primaryVideoPath

primaryVideoAlt.fieldDescription: Alternative text for the video (for accessibility)
primaryVideoAlt.name: ./primaryVideoAlt

videoStartTime.fieldDescription: Time in seconds to skip at the beginning of the video (e.g., 0.5, 1, 2)
videoStartTime.name: ./videoStartTime

ctaDescription.text: Configure the call-to-action pill button that appears as an overlay on the image section.

ctaLink.fieldDescription: URL for the CTA button. Can be internal page path or external URL.
ctaLink.name: ./ctaLink

ctaText.fieldDescription: Text displayed on the CTA button (e.g., 'Start creating', 'Learn more')
ctaText.name: ./ctaText

ctaExternal.fieldDescription: Open the CTA link in a new browser tab
ctaExternal.name: ./ctaExternal

ctaPosition.fieldDescription: Position of the CTA button overlay on the image
ctaPosition.name: ./ctaPosition

overlayImageDescription.text: A circular image overlay that appears on top of the main blob shape.

overlayImagePath.fieldDescription: Select a circular overlay image from DAM
overlayImagePath.name: ./overlayImagePath

overlayImageAlt.fieldDescription: Alternative text for the overlay image
overlayImageAlt.name: ./overlayImageAlt

overlayCardDescription.text: A pill-shaped card with image, title, and subtitle that appears as an overlay.

overlayCardImagePath.fieldDescription: Select an image for the overlay card from DAM
overlayCardImagePath.name: ./overlayCardImagePath

overlayCardTitle.fieldDescription: Title text for the overlay card (e.g., 'New York')
overlayCardTitle.name: ./overlayCardTitle

overlayCardSubtitle.fieldDescription: Subtitle text for the overlay card (e.g., '253 Broadway')
overlayCardSubtitle.name: ./overlayCardSubtitle

iconBadgeDescription.text: Configure an optional icon badge that appears as a circular overlay on the image section.

iconBadgeImage.fieldDescription: Select an icon image (SVG recommended) from DAM for the badge overlay
iconBadgeImage.name: ./iconBadgeImage

iconBadgeAlt.fieldDescription: Alternative text for the icon badge (for accessibility)
iconBadgeAlt.name: ./iconBadgeAlt

iconBadgePosition.fieldDescription: Position of the icon badge on the image
iconBadgePosition.name: ./iconBadgePosition

shapePattern.fieldDescription: Select the clip-path shape pattern for the image/video container
shapePattern.name: ./shapePattern

v3.text: Shape V3 - Two Curved Shapes Pattern

v5.text: Shape V5 - Four Vertical Capsule Pattern

imageAlignment.fieldDescription: Position of the image/video relative to the content
imageAlignment.name: ./imageAlignment

withBackground.fieldDescription: Apply a background color to the section
withBackground.name: ./withBackground

withCardBackground.fieldDescription: Apply a background color to the card container
withCardBackground.name: ./withCardBackground
